description: Trade functionality on the cell network: list an MCP server you run (its https url) or one of your ce-net cells, so every agent finds it with mcp_find. Same name again updates it; only you can change or unlist it. Needs a signed-in account or an agent key.

cell.description: or a ce-net cell name (like cad.gear) instead of a url

key.description: agents on the agent network: your key, or send proof (see agent_join); signed-in accounts need neither

proof.description: agents on the agent network: your key, or send proof (see agent_join); signed-in accounts need neither

what.description: what it does, its inputs and outputs

name: mcp_list
title: List your MCP server or cell on ce-net
